kept.name: qwen38-27b-200k-on-16gb
kept.reason: Step-by-step recipe for running Qwen 3.8 27B at about 196K context on a single 16GB GPU, which is the user's exact starting setup.

kept.name: llama-cpp-adaptive-kv-streaming
kept.reason: llama.cpp fork that moves KV cache pages between host RAM and the GPU, letting Qwen3.8-27B reach 256K context on 16GB VRAM. The 64GB of RAM makes this usable.

kept.name: large-moe-consumer-hardware
kept.reason: Guide to llama.cpp --cpu-moe offload (attention on a 16GB GPU, experts in RAM), plus KV cache sizing at 262K context and memory budgeting.

kept.name: strata
kept.reason: One-click engine for running Qwen3.8-Flash-Next MoE on 12-24GB consumer GPUs with expert offload. Covers both the 16GB and 24GB tiers.

kept.name: freetoken
kept.reason: MoE inference engine that keeps experts in system RAM and caches the active ones on the GPU, with context reuse for agent sessions. A close alternative for running bigger models on limited VRAM.

kept.name: kv-cache-vram-sizing
kept.reason: Formula for working out how much memory the KV cache needs at long context. Needed to plan context size at 16, 24 and 48GB.

kept.name: turboquant
kept.reason: 3-4 bit KV cache compression that stretches how much context fits in a fixed amount of VRAM.

kept.name: qwen3-6-27b
kept.reason: Candidate open-weight 27B coding model with 262K context. Notes that it needs quantization to run on one GPU.

kept.name: qwopus38-27b-flash
kept.reason: More efficient GGUF variant of Qwen3.8-27B that cuts runaway reasoning and was tested on agent tasks. A good fit for 24-48GB cards.

kept.name: qwen3-8-27b-uncensored-hauhaucs-aggressive-gguf
kept.reason: Qwen3.8-27B GGUF published at several quant levels with an MTP sidecar, so it maps to the 16/24/48GB tiers. Use with caution: it comes from a pseudonymous publisher and has its safety refusals stripped out.

kept.name: qwen25-coder-32b
kept.reason: Older code-specialized 32B model with 128K context via YaRN. A fallback option for a 24GB or 48GB card.

kept.name: local-model-picks-2026
kept.reason: Curated list of local models with their memory requirements, useful for choosing a model at each hardware size.

kept.name: llmfit
kept.reason: CLI that detects your hardware and scores which models will fit, run well, and support enough context. Directly answers which model to pick for each card size.

kept.name: lm-studio
kept.reason: Local model runner that estimates VRAM fit, controls GPU offload, and serves an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API that coding agents can connect to.
